text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: “Pack up, luggage! Alstroemeria☆”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, now my summer camp prep is perfect!
Who knew speed-up magic could be used for packing, too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, puppy?
While I'm away at camp, you're in charge of guarding this room—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...What, you want to come too? Hmph,
you're such a lonely little thing. Fine, I guess I'll take you with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer was in full swing, and the training camp with Sweep Tosho began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How this period is spent is vital for a horsegirl,
so I paid close attention to her physical condition to ensure the best possible training.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... Ughhh, it's so hot!
choice_data_list: Good work! Go rest in the shade!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *gulp*... *gulp*... *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Familiar, where are you going?!
choice_data_list: Setting up the next drill! Just rest, Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez, always bustling around...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Telling me to rest
while you're the one running all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Then when are YOU gonna rest?
Even Doggo agrees with me, right?

text_block_list.name: Local Lady A
text_block_list.text:
It sure is scorching today.
On days like this, nothing beats drinking that!

text_block_list.name: Local Lady B
text_block_list.text: Magic juice, huh? Guess we'll have to head up the mountain to pick some ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic...!? What are you talking about!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The training camp menu continued on after that, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the break ended, Sweep Tosho has been
plowing through the menu with incredible focus!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... That's it for today, right?
In that case, I'm heading to the mountain!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Training's over, so I'm free, right?
There's something I absolutely have to find on the mountain—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh, why are you following me? I'm faster on my own!
choice_data_list: I'm worried about you going alone.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you're panting and out of breath!
Don't you dare get in my way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, ugh, ugh! This is ridiculous!
They said I'd find it right away if I climbed up here~~~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Not here either... Ugh, why can't I find it already~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, that's why I'm in a hurry!
Instead of complaining, help me out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Here, search with this little guy!
It's a jagged green leaf!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The face of the stuffed toy she thrust at me somehow
looked like it was saying, 'Please keep watching over her a little longer.'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It has to be here! I'm the Magical Girl Sweepie, I'll definitely find it—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing the future Great Witch can't find...
Wait, ah...!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Yes! Look, familiar, I finally found it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After descending, I was told to wait for a while, so I took a walk along the beach—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, so this is where you were? I was looking for you!
Honestly, you're such a handful!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, familiar, rejoice! I'll let you have a special drink, just for you.
It's Sweepie's special 'Magical Potion'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a magic potion made with medicinal herbs famous in this area!
I even cast a spell on it to prevent summer fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Turns out that mountain hike was all to forage for medicinal herbs. Preventing summer fatigue... Was she worried about my health?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's not like I did it for my familiar or anything! It's just magic practice.
I need to see if it works, so hurry up and drink it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, it's super bitter, so you'd better brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to Sweep Tosho's word,
the magical potion tasted absolutely dreadful!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Look at your face, familiar!
I only gave it a tiny lick and went 'bleeech!'
choice_data_list: The taste was intense... but I do feel refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! I'm gonna be the greatest witch ever, remember?
Of course my potion's effects are top-notch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, a massive firework shot up into the sky,
illuminating the nighttime beach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whissshh... BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Look at that huge firework!
Amazing, so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, I have to show it to Wanko, too.
Look, it's an amazing firework!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What? You look like you want to say something again.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you're off the mark again.
I told you, it's not for my familiar, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I didn't say anything! Besides, there's still potion left, so make sure you drink it tomorrow, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she said that and hugged her plushie, Sweep Tosho's cheeks looked flushed red, perhaps from the glow of the fireworks.
